name: Mimnermus
bio: Mimnermus is one of the epigrammatists whose short poems were gathered in the Greek Anthology. Paton's index of authors dates the poet to 7th century BC.
This archive carries the 1 epigram ascribed to the poet in the third volume of W. R. Paton's prose translation (Book IX: 50).

poems.title: Book IX, 50: Not an Epigram, but a Couplet from an Elegy
poems.author: Mimnermus
poems.text: Rejoice thy own heart, but of thy ill-disposed countrymen one shall speak ill of thee and another well.

poems.title: Requiesce Anima (Mackail)
poems.author: Mimnermus
poems.collection: Select Epigrams from the Greek Anthology (1890)
poems.text: Be young, dear my soul: soon will others be men, and I being dead shall be dark earth.

poems.title: Carpe Diem
poems.author: Mimnermus
poems.text:
Hold fast thine youth, dear soul of mine, new lives will come to birth,
And I that shall have passed away be one with the brown earth.
